_readme: Site settings. google: paste your IDs to switch measurement on (a cookie-consent bar appears automatically; nothing loads before the visitor agrees). Leave empty = no Google, no cookies. legal: shown in the Privacy Policy / Imprint. recaptcha.site_key: the PUBLIC reCAPTCHA v3 site key (the secret key goes into api/config.php). mac.status: "soon" = the macOS download is shown as coming soon on every page and /usage-api/dl.php?os=mac does not hand out the package; "" = normal. Installed copies keep their update channel either way.

store_legal._readme: Microsoft Store version (Usage Monitor for Claude AI): its publisher is the data controller. tools/build_store_privacy.py builds legal/store-hu.html and store-en.html from this. Keep equal to STORE_CONTROLLER in the app (claude_usage/store.py).
store_legal.name: 30 km.hu Kft.

store._readme: Microsoft Store version. live: false = the 'also in the Microsoft Store' line under the Windows download is left out of every page; set it to true once the product page is public, then rebuild (tools/build_site.py) and deploy.
